# Support

Use the issue forms for reproducible supported-core defects, adapter compatibility reports, and bounded feature proposals. General setup and workflow questions can use the feature form until GitHub Discussions is explicitly enabled.

This community project provides no guaranteed response time. Include redacted `bin/orch doctor` output, OS/Bash version, selected CLI version, and the smallest reproducer.

Security vulnerabilities must follow `SECURITY.md` and must not be posted publicly.
